name: claude-bridge
description: Bridge from Codex and other agents to Claude CLI for review, adversarial review, and rescue passes.

interface.shortDescription: Use Claude CLI for external passes.
interface.longDescription: Claude Bridge provides Codex skills that call the local Claude CLI for ordinary reviews, adversarial challenge reviews, and rescue-style investigation or follow-up work. It keeps review runs read-only, normalizes Claude model names, and verifies findings before treating them as fact.
defaultPrompt: Ask Claude to review my local changes.
Ask Claude for an adversarial review of this diff.
Ask Claude to rescue this failing investigation.
